The spread matters. The 90th-percentile threshold for research scientists is $230,630—more than $90,000 above the occupation’s median.

How to read this: A 10th- or 90th-percentile figure is a threshold, not a minimum or maximum salary. These are national occupational wages, not AI-specific pay or total compensation. BLS counts straight-time gross pay and excludes stock bonuses. Sources: data scientists, software developers, research scientists, IT managers, and OEWS wage definitions. Snapshot reviewed September 27, 2026.
